We evaluate our method on two sub-tasks in DVC. By using the official evaluation tool, we use CIDEr (Vedantam et al., 2015), BLEU4, and METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005) metrics, which compare the generated captions to the ground truth across IoU thresholds of (0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9). Additionally, to assess storytelling ability, we use the SODA_c metric.
